Weapon Kills grant the following benefits to hip-firing for #e${7+#d} seconds:
• 30 Stability
• 45% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• ~3° larger Precision Aim Angle
• 95%? decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 95%? decreased <title Accuracy Cone Growth [G_conegrowth] />.

Buff is removed on stow.
